summary.plain: The ND detector at VEPP-2M: four layers of sodium iodide crystal counters around the collision point that measured photon energies.
summary.technical: ND: 168 rectangular NaI(Tl) scintillation counters in four layers around the interaction region.

technology.locator: Silagadze, essay on the SND site, section I
technology.quote: Its main part was a scintillation electromagnetic calorimeter, consisting of 168 rectangular counters with NaI(Tl) crystals arranged in four layers around the interaction region.
